title: Mechanical Design Lead
description:
Key Roles & Responsibilities Mechanical Lead (Plant Design) 1. Mechanical Engineering & Plant Design Lead conceptual, basic and detailed mechanical engineering for industrial EPC projects. Oversee plant layouts, equipment arrangements, piping designs and 3D plant modeling. Review PFDs, P&IDs, engineering specifications and mechanical design deliverables. Ensure compliance with applicable ASME, API, ASTM, IS and other engineering standards. 2. Equipment & Piping Engineering Lead engineering of static and rotating equipment, including vessels, tanks, heat exchangers, pumps and utility systems. Supervise piping layouts, isometrics, material specifications, pipe supports and stress analysis coordination. Review equipment datasheets, GA drawings, technical specifications, MTOs and BOQs. Ensure design accuracy, operational safety, maintainability and constructability. 3. Engineering Deliverables & Quality Plan, allocate, review and ensure timely completion of mechanical engineering deliverables. Conduct design reviews, 3D model reviews, clash detection and technical validations. Implement engineering quality standards, design optimization and document control procedures. Minimize design revisions, engineering errors and site rework. 4. Multidisciplinary & Vendor Coordination Coordinate with Process, Civil, Structural, Electrical, Instrumentation and Project Execution teams. Prepare technical requisitions, evaluate vendor proposals and review vendor drawings. Resolve design interfaces, technical queries and engineering challenges. Participate in client meetings, technical discussions and engineering reviews. 5. Project Execution & Site Support Provide engineering support during procurement, construction, installation and commissioning. Resolve site technical issues, design modifications and engineering change requests. Coordinate with project managers to meet engineering schedules and project milestones. Support value engineering, material optimization and cost-effective design solutions. 6. Team Leadership & Performance Lead, mentor and supervise mechanical engineers, piping designers and 3D modelers. Monitor engineering productivity, deliverable quality, resource utilization and timelines. Establish standardized engineering practices and drive continuous improvement. Ensure ownership, accountability and effective collaboration across engineering teams.

Key Skills: Project,Layout design,Piping,Project engineering management,Isometrics,Equipment,Modeling,Mechanical engineering
